lane_status._doc: NOT a revival of multi-1's killed signal. multi-1 STOPPED_ON_NULL because ITS scorer (the fork) is a volatility detector. This lane scores with production filters.py -- a different scorer, with its own frozen prereg, as multi-1's own kill rule demands.

_doc: TICKERS LANE -- three DEDICATED paper accounts trading non-SPY 0DTE options with the PRODUCTION SPY scoring (backtest/lib/filters.py evaluate_*_setup) on the multi lane's plumbing (funnel, expiry, strike, liquidity gate, sizing, exits, broker). J 2026-09-04 00:4x ET: 'wire these 3 accounts for all non SPY options trading ... just like how we trade spy 0dte'. This is the experiment no prior non-SPY test ran: every off-SPY null (weekly 684 fills, multi 7,489 signals, catalyst 7,019 signals) scored a COPY of the engine (multi/lib/filters.py). Here the scorer is the original. Prereg: analysis/recommendations/prereg-tickers-lane-production-scorer-2026-09-04.json.
_status: ACTIVE_PAPER -- armed for paper fills from 2026-09-04; live:false is permanent here (OP-0 #1)
_separation: This lane NEVER imports, modifies, or shares state with the SPY engine or the crypto twin. Three dedicated accounts; per-arm state under automation/state/tickers/<arm>/; its own journal journal/trades-tickers-<arm>.csv. Its P&L is evidence ONLY for this lane's own prereg.

mode.name: intraday_v1
mode._doc: WHAT BUSINESS THIS LANE IS IN. J directive 2026-08-19/20: replicate the engine that has recent green evidence -- the INTRADAY SPY machine -- on more names. The multi-day model this lane originally carried was inherited from the weekly lane, whose signal died a five-cut null-gate death (WEEKLY-EXPIRY-EXPERIMENT-2026-08-18.md). Multi-day is not forbidden forever; it is DORMANT until intraday replication has evidence. See _dormant_multiday below -- kept, not deleted, so reviving it is a config change not an archaeology project.
mode._time_stop_doc: Mirrors the SPY engine's own hard time-stop. The expiry-day flatten schedule (flatten_schedule_et 14:45/14:50/14:55) still takes precedence when the position's contract expires TODAY -- that is a safety cutoff, not a profit rule, and it fires first.

universe._doc: The SAME nine names as arms.*.universe, in their sector buckets. Two consumers need the buckets even though scoring uses the per-arm lists: multi/lib/risk.py's sector cap looks a symbol's sector up here and FAILS CLOSED on an unknown one (E2E probe 2026-09-04 01:44 ET: NVDA BLOCKED at risk_admitted -- 'not found in any params.universe sector bucket'), and multi/lib/broker.py::universe_roots() scopes which option roots the flatten may touch. SPY is NEVER here (the executor asserts it on every arm universe).

liquidity_gate._doc: Checked LIVE at decision time, per symbol, per contract -- never from a static universe list. This is the fix for the static-screen failure: catalyst days create their own liquidity.
liquidity_gate._min_premium_note: Added pre-window on the 2026-09-04 review: a sub-$0.20 0DTE contract x3 is lottery noise, not a trade.
liquidity_gate._feed_note: No OPRA agreement on this account: every spread number is from the free indicative feed. Permanent disclosure on every row.

_dormant_multiday._why_dormant: multi-day hold model; revive only with intraday evidence in hand

entry._expiry_doc: INTRADAY: take the nearest LISTED expiry (0-3 DTE typical). Still read from the live chain, never a computed calendar -- an expiry can be absent because earnings land that day (verified: NVDA had no 2026-08-26 listing).

risk._cap_note: 5% of equity. The executor HARD-CLAMPS qty to risk.max_contracts (3), so this pct is not the risk control -- it only has to be large enough that size_entry() can AFFORD the Rule-6 minimum of 3 contracts. At 2% a $9.4K account could afford 1 contract of a $1.19 NVDA option (E2E probe 2026-09-04 01:5x ET: BLOCKED sized_ok, 'max affordable 1 < min_contracts 3'); on a $100K paper account 5% = $5,000 covers 3 contracts up to a $16 premium, and on a $10K account still covers NVDA/AAPL/AMZN-class premiums. A name whose 3-lot exceeds the cap is SIZE_BELOW_MIN -- refused, never rounded up.
risk._max_contracts_doc: HARD CLAMP enforced by multi/execute.py AFTER size_entry(): a $100K paper account would otherwise size ~90 contracts of a $2 option. Rule 6 minimum is 3 (2 TP + 1 runner); day one trades EXACTLY 3, matching the SPY arms. Raising this is a risk EXPANSION -> waits for evidence, never a tweak.
risk._max_concurrent_doc: One position at a time per arm (SPY doctrine: one at a time). Three arms = at most three open contracts book-wide, never the same contract twice.
risk._kill_doc: 1% of equity (~$1,000 on $100K paper) blocks NEW entries for the day. Exits and the flatten always run.
risk._per_trade_risk_cap_doc: AFFORDABILITY knob, not the risk control -- the executor hard-clamps qty to max_contracts (3). 0.30 = Rule 6's Safe value. Set 2026-09-04 03:5x ET when tickers_verify.py showed the three accounts are $5,000 each, not the $100K the prereg assumed: at 0.05 a $5K account could only afford a 3-lot up to a $0.83 premium and most of the universe (NVDA ~$1.2, AAPL ~$2.2, QQQ ~$3.2) would have been SIZE_BELOW_MIN at the open. At 0.30 ($1,500) a 3-lot is affordable up to a $5.00 premium; a name whose 3-lot exceeds it (TSLA ~$5.5) is refused, never rounded up. daily_loss_kill_switch_pct stays 0.01 ($50 on $5K = one losing 3-lot ends the arm's day) -- the prereg froze it and raising it is a risk expansion; revisit on a weekend, in writing, if the window shows it binding.

exits._doc: Starting values ported from the SPY engine's shapes. They were fitted on SPY 0DTE fills and are NOT validated on these underlyings or these DTEs. Paired shadow-clock logs the ported shape alongside any variant from the first signal.

theta_budget.thesis_progress_definition: underlying has moved >= 0.5 * ATR(14) in the trade's direction from entry

_dormant_multiday._why_dormant: same-day exits under intraday_v1; days-to-live is meaningless intraday

exits._mode_note: Under mode.intraday_v1 the exit ladder is: expiry-day flatten (safety, first) -> theta budget (BEFORE the catastrophe cap) -> same-day time stop -> TP1/runner/trail -> catastrophe cap. days_to_live and the weekend guard are dormant, not deleted.

flatten_schedule_et._doc: Expiration-day cutoffs. Alpaca rejects option orders after ~3:15pm ET on expiration day for most names and the do-not-exercise cutoff is 3:00pm ET. A long option left to auto-exercise would deliver shares this account cannot afford.

scanners._doc: Free Alpaca surfaces, all verified working 2026-08-19. These SELECT candidates; they never place or gate a trade on their own.
scanners._verified: movers returned MRNA +177.0% on 2026-08-19, matching the independently derived figure exactly.

promotion._doc: Same bar as every other arm. No result is described as promising until it beats the randomized-entry null at its MAX.

_shadow_only_doc: false = the executor (multi/execute.py) MAY submit paper orders when it passes armed=True. multi/core.py itself still has no order path (AST-guarded). Set true to stop new entries instantly; the EOD flatten still runs.
_scorer_doc: 'production' = backtest/lib/filters.py evaluate_bearish_setup/evaluate_bullish_setup on a production BarContext (backtest/lib/ribbon.py ribbon, production 20-bar baselines). 'fork' = multi/lib/filters.py (multi-1's scorer, killed on its null). Dispatched in multi/core.py tick(); vary-and-assert guarded.

arms._doc: One params file, three accounts. The executor builds a per-arm view {**params, 'account': arms[arm]} so multi/lib/creds.resolve() is unchanged. account_number is blank until the first verify_account() discovers it; the executor pins it to automation/state/tickers/<arm>/account.json and REFUSES to run if a later resolve returns a different number (a mispasted or rotated key must never trade the wrong account).

tick_cadence._doc: 0DTE exits (a -50% catastrophe cap) cannot wait 15 minutes; 2-minute ticks keep API use ~20/min across three arms, far under the 200/min limit. Entries stop at 14:30 so nothing is opened into the 14:45 soft time stop.
